questions.question: Cinderella chose a sandal which was 37th from either end in a row of sandals. How many sandals were there in the row?
questions.solution:
As Cinderella chose a sandal which was 37th from either end in a row of sandals,

There were 36 sandals toward its right and 36 sandals toward its left,

__EXPLANATION:__

**The total number of sandals = 36(towards left of chosen sandal) + 36(towards right of chosen sandal) + 1(chosen sandal) = 73**

Hence, **“73”** is the correct answer.

questions.question: The procedure of Impeachment of the President of India is __________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is the** __Quasi-Judicial Procedure.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• The procedure of Impeachment of the President of India is the Quasi-Judicial Procedure.
 
• **The procedure** begins with the introduction of a bill in either house of Parliament.
 
• The only condition for the initiation of the impeachment of the Indian president is the **‘violation of the constitution**.
 
• None of the presidents of India has faced impeachment so far.
 
• A quasi-judicial body is an** organ of Government other than a Court or Legislature, **which affects the rights of private parties either through adjudication or rulemaking”.
 
• It is not mandatory that a Quasi-Judicial Body has to necessarily be an organization resembling a Court of Law.
 
 
• For example, the Election Commission of India is also a Quasi-Judicial Body but does not have its core functions as a Court of Law.
 
 
 
• Some examples of Quasi-Judicial Bodies in India are the Election Commission of India, the National Green Tribunal, and the Central Information Commission (CIC).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Process of Impeachment of the President of India**:

 
 
• When a President is to be impeached for violation of the Constitution, the charge shall be preferred by** either House of Parliament.**
 
• For the motion to be valid, it must be signed by at least one-fourth of the total members of the house where it is introduced
 
• In the case of the Lok Sabha, this means that the motion must be signed by at least one-fourth of the total Lok Sabha members.
 
• A 14-day notice is given to the President of India.
 
• Then, Lok Sabha passes the impeachment charges with a two-thirds majority and sends it to Rajya Sabha.
 
• Then, the Rajya Sabha investigates the charges.
 
• While Rajya Sabha is investigating the charges, the President has the right to sit in the proceedings.
 
• Rajya Sabha agrees to the charges and passes it with a two-thirds majority and the President is removed.

questions.question: The average weight of 20 students in a group is 54 kg. If 12 students of average weight 52 kg join the group and 7 students of average weight 56 kg leave the group, then what will be the average weight (in kg) of the remaining students in the group?
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

Average weight of 20 students = 54 kg

Average weight of 12 students = 52 kg

Average weight of 7 students = 56 kg

**Formula used:-**

Average = (Sum of all weight)/(Total no. of weight)

**Calculation:-**

According to question-

⇒ (Sum of 20 students)/20 = 54

⇒ Sum of 20 students = 54 × 20

⇒ Sum of 20 students = 1080

∴ Sum of 12 students = 52 × 12

⇒ Sum of 12 students = 624

⇒ Sum of 7 students = 56 × 7

⇒ Sum of 7 students = 392

Average of remaining students = (Sum of 20 students + Sum of 12 students - Sum of 7 students)/(20 + 12 - 7)

Average of remaining students = (1080 + 624 - 392)/25

Average of remaining students = 1312/25 = 52.48

∴ **Average of remaining students is 52.48. **

questions.question: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral such that ∠B = 104°. The tangents at A and C meet at a point P. What is the measure of ∠APC?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ∠B = 104°

**Formula used:**

Opposite angles of the cyclic quadrilateral = 180° 

**Calculation:**

In given cyclic quadrilateral ABCD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/300576c2846eba58b7f34b920ae0acb593bf099b6a9812d3e5d945ee1995189a.png] 

⇒ ∠ABC + ∠ADC = 180° 

⇒ ∠ADC = 180° - 104° = 76° 

Since PA is tangent on the circle at point A and AC is the cord which is subtending the angle ∠D = 76°

 

The angle between a tangent and a chord of a circle is equal to the angle subtended by the chord in the alternate segment of the circle.

In this case, the tangent at point A (line segment PA) and chord AC subtend ∠PAC in the alternate segment, which is equal to the angle ∠D subtended by the same chord AC. Therefore, ∠PAC = ∠D = 76°.

⇒ ∠PAC = ∠D = 76°

Also,

⇒ ∠PAC = ∠PCA, (As PA and PC are the tangents of A and C) 

⇒ ∠PAC = ∠PCA = ∠ADC = 76° 

In ΔPAC

⇒ ∠PAC + ∠PCA + ∠APC = 180° 

⇒ 76° + 76° + ∠APC = 180° 

⇒ ∠APC = 180° - 152° = 28° 

**∴ The required result will be 28°.**

questions.question: Find the value when LCM is divided by HCF of the numbers - 405, 648, and 486.
questions.solution:
**Given:** 

Numbers = 405, 648 & 486

**Calculation:**

LCM of 405, 648, and 486

405 = 3⁴ × 5

648 = 2³ × 3⁴

486 = 2 × 3⁵

LCM = 2³ × 3⁵ × 5 = 9720

Now, HCF of 405, 648 & 486 = 3⁴ = 81

LCM/HCF = 9720/81 = 120

**Hence, the correct answer is 120.**

questions.question: Which of the following statements Is **correct** ?

options.text: Assimilation of food takes place in large intestine.
Large intestine has finger like projection called villi.
Large intestine is wider and shorter than small intestine.
Absorption of digested food takes place in large intestine.

questions.solution:
**__Concept:__**

Digestion: It is the breakdown of large insoluble food molecules into small water-soluble food molecules so that they can be absorbed into the watery blood plasma.

Digestion begins in the mouth with chewing and ends in the small intestine.

Functions of Various Organs Associated with Digestion:

__
 
• Stomach: It holds food while it is being mixed with enzymes that continue the process of breaking down food into a usable form. It also secretes acid and enzymes that digest food. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51cb49adffa7e9a97a9c50e4a886a87db897df2e1d212e80ecfb40e9b0d78e93.png] 

 
• Small Intestine: Here **90% of the digestion and absorption** of food occurs, the other **10% **takes place in the **stomach **and **large intestine**.

 
 
• The main function of the wall of the small intestine is the absorption of nutrients and minerals from food.
 
• The small intestine is the "workhorse" of digestion.
 
• The Villi are found inside the small intestine to absorption of nutrients from the digested food.
 
 
• They are **f****in**ger-like projections inside the small intestine to increase their surface area to absorb essential nutrients from the food.
 
• They have thin walls and mostly covered with a thin channel of blood capillaries so, the nutrients can be absorbed by blood and easily transport
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c83cf86e8080e6aff64005d7fc8aeba33fff4b6a0710c57e438c91f89d614ede.png] 

 
• Large intestine: Absorbing water and electrolytes, producing and absorbing vitamins are three main functions of the large intestine.
 
• Liver: The main function of the liver is within the digestive system is to process the nutrients absorbed from the small intestine. 

**Explanation:__**

 
• The **large intestine is wider and shorter than the small intestine** (approximately 1.5 metres, or 5 feet, in length as compared with 6.7 to 7.6 metres, or 22 to 25 feet, in length for the small intestine) and has a smooth inner wall.
 
• The Villi are found inside the small intestine to absorption of nutrients from the digested food.
 
• The purpose of the **large intestine** is to absorb water and salts from the material that has not been **digested** as **food** and get rid of any waste products left over.
 
• By the time **food** mixed with digestive juices reaches your **large intestine**, most **digestion** and **absorption** has already **taken place **in** the small **intestine.
 
• The liver is important in assimilation.
 
• For example, it converts glucose into glycogen (a complex carbohydrate used for storage) and amino acids into proteins. The liver is involved in the process of delamination.

So, the correct statement is "**Large intestine is wider and shorter than the small intestine**."

questions.question: A shopkeeper sold a book at a loss of 14%. If the selling price had been increased by Rs. 100, there would have been a gain of 6%. What was the cost price of the book?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total percentage difference between a **14% loss** and a **6% gain** is 14% + 6% = 20%.

This 20% change in the **Cost Price (CP)** corresponds to the **Rs. 100** increase in **Selling Price**.

20% of **CP** = Rs. 100

100% (Total **CP**) = (100 ÷ 20) × 100 = 5 × 100 = Rs. 500.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial **Loss** percentage = 14%

Final **Gain** percentage = 6%

Difference in **Selling Price (SP)** = Rs. 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66099448f2f4639aea0aff3bbfe3cbb640b5af1b0013d06fba0b2b2ff15f8b22.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the **Cost Price (CP)** of the book be Rs. x.

⇒ First **Selling Price (SP₁)** = CP − 14% of CP = 86% of x

⇒ Second **Selling Price (SP₂)** = CP + 6% of CP = 106% of x

⇒ Difference = SP₂ − SP₁ = 106% of x − 86% of x

⇒ 20% of x = 100

⇒ (20 ÷ 100) × x = 100

⇒ x = (100 × 100) ÷ 20

⇒ x = 500

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit and Loss Formula

**Gain** = SP − CP and **Loss** = CP − SP. **Profit %** or **Loss %** is always calculated on the **Cost Price**.

Direct CP Calculation

When there is a shift from **Loss %** to **Gain %**, the formula for **CP** is: [Amount of Difference ÷ (Loss% + Gain%)] × 100.

Marked Price and Discount

**Discount** is always calculated on the **Marked Price (MP)**. SP = MP − Discount.</p

questions.question: If a + b = 7 and ab = 12, then what will be the value of a² + b² ?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Apply the direct identity: **a² + b² = (a + b)² − 2ab**

Given: **a + b = 7** and **ab = 12**

Substitute the values: **7² − 2(12)**

Calculation: **49 − 24 = 25**

**∴ The correct answer is 25.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** The sum of two variables is **a + b = 7** and their product is **ab = 12**.

**Formula Used:** We use the standard algebraic identity for the square of a binomial: **(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5ed083aa73f4456b255d133cd79da8ad75cf4db635357e32de10af1762b8f5d.png] 

⇒ (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

⇒ (7)² = a² + b² + 2(12)

⇒ 49 = a² + b² + 24

⇒ a² + b² = 49 − 24

⇒ a² + b² = 25

**∴ The correct answer is 25.**

**__Additional Information__**

Square of Difference

The identity for the square of a difference is **(a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab**.

Difference of Squares

The factorization for the difference of two squares is **a² − b² = (a + b)(a − b)**.

Sum and Difference Relationship

The relationship between the sum and difference squares is **(a + b)² − (a − b)² = 4ab**.</p

questions.question: If a thirteen-digit number 507x13219256y is divisible by 72, then the maximum value of sqrt{5x+3y} will be :
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

For divisibility by 72, the number must be divisible by both 8 and 9.

The last 3 digits 56y must be divisible by 8, giving y = 0 or y = 8.

Sum of digits = 41 + x + y. For divisibility by 9, take y = 8 to maximize the result → 49 + x = 54 → x = 5.

Maximum value of √(5x + 3y) = √(5×5 + 3×8) = √(25 + 24) = √49 = 7.

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number = 507x13219256y

Divisor = 72

**Formula Used:**

For divisibility by 72, the number must be exactly divisible by 8 and 9.

Divisibility by 8: The last three digits must be divisible by 8.

Divisibility by 9: The sum of digits must be divisible by 9.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Last three digits are 56y.

⇒ For y = 0, 560 is divisible by 8. For y = 8, 568 is divisible by 8.

⇒ Possible values for y are 0 and 8.

⇒ Sum of digits = 5 + 0 + 7 + x + 1 + 3 + 2 + 1 + 9 + 2 + 5 + 6 + y = 41 + x + y

⇒ Case 1: When y = 0

⇒ Sum = 41 + x + 0 = 41 + x

⇒ The nearest multiple of 9 greater than 41 is 45.

⇒ 41 + x = 45 ⇒ x = 4

⇒ Value = √(5x + 3y) = √(5×4 + 3×0) = √20

⇒ Case 2: When y = 8

⇒ Sum = 41 + x + 8 = 49 + x

⇒ The nearest multiple of 9 greater than 49 is 54.

⇒ 49 + x = 54 ⇒ x = 5

⇒ Value = √(5x + 3y) = √(5×5 + 3×8) = √49 = 7

⇒ Comparing both cases, the maximum value is 7 (since 7 > √20).

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

**__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 8

A number is divisible by 8 if the number formed by its last three digits is divisible by 8.

Divisibility Rule of 9

A number is divisible by 9 if the sum of all its digits is a multiple of 9.

Divisibility Rule of 11

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of digits at odd places and even places is 0 or a multiple of 11.

Co-prime Divisors Rule

If a number is divisible by two co-prime numbers a and b, it is also divisible by their product (a × b). Here, 72 = 8 × 9.
</p

questions.question: If one of the angles of a triangle is 120°, then the angle between the bisectors of the other two angles is :
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In any **triangle**, the angle formed by the **internal bisectors** of two angles (say ∠B and ∠C) at the **incenter** (I) is related to the third angle (∠A) by the formula:

Angle between bisectors = 90° + (∠A ÷ 2)

Given ∠A = 120°

⇒ Required Angle = 90° + (120° ÷ 2)

⇒ Required Angle = 90° + 60° = 150°

**∴ The correct answer is 150°ree;.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

One angle of the **triangle** (∠A) = 120°

The other two angles are ∠B and ∠C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/085e8cd38056d949430e8fe5a86f70e1eb3435beba6251e84a58ce9345f49f8c.png] 

**Property Used:** Sum of interior angles of a triangle is 180°.

⇒ In ΔABC, ∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180°

⇒ 120° + ∠B + ∠C = 180°

⇒ ∠B + ∠C = 180° − 120° = 60°

Let **I** be the point of intersection of the **bisectors** of ∠B and ∠C.

⇒ In ΔBIC, the sum of angles is also 180°:

⇒ ∠BIC + ∠IBC + ∠ICB = 180°

⇒ Since BI and CI are bisectors, ∠IBC = ∠B ÷ 2 and ∠ICB = ∠C ÷ 2.

⇒ ∠BIC + (∠B ÷ 2) + (∠C ÷ 2) = 180°

⇒ ∠BIC + (∠B + ∠C) ÷ 2 = 180°

⇒ ∠BIC + (60° ÷ 2) = 180°

⇒ ∠BIC + 30° = 180°

⇒ ∠BIC = 180° − 30° = 150°

**∴ The correct answer is 150°ree;.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Incenter

The point where all internal **angle bisectors** of a triangle meet. It is the center of the **incircle**.

Angle at Excenter

The angle formed by the **external bisectors** of two angles of a triangle is given by the formula 90° − (∠A ÷ 2).

Angle in a Straight Line

Internal bisector and external bisector of the same angle are always **perpendicular** (form a 90° angle) to each other.</p

questions.question: Ramu can do a work in 36 days and Kanu in 32 days. If they work on it together for 12 days, then what fraction of work is left?

Work done by Ramu in 12 days = 12 ÷ 36 = 1/3

Work done by Kanu in 12 days = 12 ÷ 32 = 3/8

Total work done together in 12 days = 1/3 + 3/8 = (8 + 9) / 24 = 17/24

Fraction of work left = 1 − 17/24 = 7/24

**∴ The correct answer is 7/24.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total combined efficiency of Ramu and Kanu = 8 + 9 = 17 units/day

⇒ Total work done by both in 12 days = 17 × 12 = 204 units

⇒ Fraction of work left = Remaining Work ÷ Total Work

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 4,000 is lent at 10% p.a., interest compounded annually. What is the difference between the compound interest for the 2ⁿd year and the 3rd year?
questions.solution:
Given:

Interest rate = 10%

Principal Amount = Rs. 4000

Time = 3 years

Concept used:

Compound interest, CI = P(1 + R/100)n - P

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

N = Time in years

Calculation:

Principal amount become at the end of the second year = 4000 (1 + 10/100)² = Rs. 4840

Principal amount at the beginning of the second year = 4000 (1 + 10/100)¹ = Rs. 4400

Interest incurred in the second year = 4840 - 4400 = Rs. 440

Principal amount become at the end of 3rd year = 4000 (1 + 10/100)3 = Rs. 5324

Principal amount at the beginning of the third year = Rs. 4840

Interest incurred in the third year = 5324 - 4840 = Rs. 484

Difference between the compound interest incurred in the third and second year = 484 - 440 = Rs. 44

**∴ Rs. 44 is the difference between the compound interest for the 2nd year and the 3rd year.**

Cost Price (CP) = SP − Profit = 5 − 1 = 4 units.

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

⇒ Profit = 20% of 100 = 20 units

⇒ Cost Price (CP) = 100 − 20 = 80 units

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Arrange the data in **ascending order** to find the middle term.

The **Mode** is the most frequently occurring value, which is 31.

The **Median** for 17 terms is the 9th term, which is 14.

Required **Difference** = 31 − 14 = 17.

**∴ The correct answer is 17.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Data set = {2.1, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9.3, 11, 15, 17, 19.21, 27, 31, 31, 33, 16.5, 14, 10}

**Formula Used:**

1. **Mode** = Value with the highest frequency.

2. **Median** (if n is odd) = ((n + 1) ÷ 2)th term of the sorted data.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1992ca9a18d25af89690437a7f08f2e5d0116cc2d04fe349b299daaa044a332.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Arrange in ascending order: 2.1, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9.3, 10, 11, **14**, 15, 16.5, 17, 19.21, 27, **31**, **31**, 33

⇒ Total number of observations (n) = 17

⇒ **Median** = ((17 + 1) ÷ 2)th term = 9th term

⇒ 9th term = 14

⇒ In the data set, 31 occurs twice, which is the highest frequency.

⇒ **Mode** = 31

⇒ Required Difference = |Median − Mode|

⇒ Difference = 31 − 14 = 17

**∴ The correct answer is 17.**

For a moderately skewed distribution, the relationship is: **Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean**.

Median for Even observations

Range of Data

Range = Maximum Value − Minimum Value. For this set, Range = 33 − 2.1 = 30.9.</p

questions.question: A cardboard sheet in the form of a circular sector of radius 30 cm and central angle 144° is folded to make a cone. What is the radius of the cone?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When a **circular sector** is folded into a **cone**, the radius of the cone (r) is given by:

r = (θ ÷ 360) × R

Where θ = 144° and R = 30 cm (Sector Radius).

⇒ r = (144 ÷ 360) × 30 = (2 ÷ 5) × 30 = 12 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ **Radius of the sector** (R) = 30 cm

⇒ **Central angle** (θ) = 144°

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Arc length of sector = (θ ÷ 360) × 2πR

⇒ Circumference of cone base = 2πr

⇒ Slant height of cone (l) = Radius of sector (R)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2954834f37f78cd37a4d471c7c8afda121cbce4f5ab4957590c510e46132b81.png] 

**Calculations:**

The **arc length** of the sector becomes the **circumference** of the base of the cone.

⇒ Circumference of cone = Arc length of sector

⇒ 2 × π × r = (144 ÷ 360) × 2 × π × 30

Cancelling 2π from both sides:

⇒ r = (144 ÷ 360) × 30

⇒ r = (12 ÷ 30) × 30

⇒ r = 12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Ravi : Raju** = (50,000 × 12) : (1,00,000 × 6)

**Ravi : Raju** = 6,00,000 : 6,00,000 = 1 : 1

Since the ratio is 1 : 1, the profit is divided **equally**.

**Raju profit share** = ₹63,000 ÷ 2 = ₹31,500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹31,500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Investment of Ravi** = ₹50,000 | **Time period** = 12 months

**Investment of Raju** = ₹1,00,000 | **Time period** = 6 months (Joined after 6 months)

**Total Annual Profit** = ₹63,000

**Formula Used:**

Profit Ratio = (Capital₁ × Time₁) : (Capital₂ × Time₂)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf357a50433f05e0b865ec88da2dbe5d8878ea11aa0cd465a0640fda81667891.png] 

⇒ Ravi profit equivalent = 50,000 × 12 = 6,00,000

⇒ Raju profit equivalent = 1,00,000 × 6 = 6,00,000

⇒ Profit Ratio (Ravi : Raju) = 6,00,000 : 6,00,000

⇒ Ratio = 1 : 1

⇒ Total Ratio Parts = 1 + 1 = 2 units

⇒ 2 units = ₹63,000

⇒ 1 unit = ₹63,000 ÷ 2 = ₹31,500

⇒ Raju share (1 unit) = ₹31,500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹31,500.**

questions.question: A hostel had food provision for 300 students for a month. After 20 days, 50 students left the hostel. How long would the remaining food last? (1 month = 30 days)
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Remaining food for **300 students** is for **10 days** (30 − 20 = 10).

Students remaining = 300 − 50 = **250 students**.

Using **M₁D₁ = M₂D₂**: 300 × 10 = 250 × D.

D = 3000 ÷ 250 = **12 days**.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 days.**

**__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca73f89cd369ca6a4a33ff132643a7593c8d0cac572a9e1735308b7c0c066bc5.png] 

**Given:**

Total students = **300**

Total provision = **30 days**

Days elapsed = **20 days**

Students left = **50**

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Work (Total food units) = 300 × 30 = **9000 units**

⇒ Food consumed in 20 days = 300 × 20 = **6000 units**

⇒ Remaining food = 9000 − 6000 = **3000 units**

⇒ Remaining students = 300 − 50 = **250 students**

⇒ Number of days food will last = 3000 ÷ 250

⇒ Days = **12 days**

**∴ The correct answer is 12 days.**

**__Additional Information__**

Chain Rule (Work and Person)

The formula used is **M₁D₁H₁/W₁ = M₂D₂H₂/W₂**, where M is men, D is days, H is hours, and W is work.

Inverse Proportion

The number of **days** is **inversely proportional** to the number of **men** for a constant amount of food/work.

Remaining Food Concept

Always calculate the **remaining man-days** by multiplying the initial number of people by the remaining number of days.</p

questions.question: The ratio of ages of five boys is 1: 2 : 3: 4: 5. and the average age of those people is 30 years. Then find the age of the youngest boy.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the ratio 1 : 2 : 3 : 4 : 5 is in **arithmetic progression**, the **average** is the **middle value**.

Middle ratio part = 3 units.

Given **average age** = 30 years ⇒ 3 units = 30 years.

1 unit = 30 ÷ 3 = 10 years.

Youngest boy age (1 unit) = 10 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 10 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Ratio of ages = 1 : 2 : 3 : 4 : 5, **Average age** = 30 years, Number of boys = 5.

**Formula:** Total Age = Average × Number of persons.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81829deef0d4723828766a8ddd87157e167cff68f6825086438b1a0c08e8306c.png] 

Let the ages of the **five boys** be 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, and 5x.

⇒ Total Age = 30 × 5 = 150 years.

⇒ 1x + 2x + 3x + 4x + 5x = 150.

⇒ 15x = 150.

⇒ x = 150 ÷ 15 = 10.

⇒ Age of the **youngest boy** = 1x = 1 × 10 = 10 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 10 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average of Arithmetic Progression (AP)

For a sequence in AP, Average = (First term + Last term) ÷ 2. In this case, (1+5)/2 = 3.

Sum of Ages Formula

Total Sum = Average × Number of entities. Useful for solving age-related problems involving groups.

Ratio Distribution

The value of any specific part = (Part Ratio ÷ Sum of Ratios) × Total Value.</p

questions.question: Which of the following amendment/s in the Indian Constitution was/were equated with ‘Mini Constitution’?
questions.solution:
The Correct answer is__** ​42nd Amendment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **42nd Amendment **of the Indian Constitution is the most comprehensive amendment to the Constitution and carried out major changes.
 
• It is also known as “mini-constitution”.
 
• Amendments:
 
 
• Added three new words (i.e., socialist, secular, and integrity) in the Preamble.
 
• Added Fundamental Duties by the citizens (new Part IV A).
 
• Made the president bound by the advice of the cabinet.
 
• Provided for administrative tribunals and tribunals for other matters (Added Part XIV A).
 
• Froze the seats in the Lok Sabha and state legislative assemblies on the basis of 1971 census till 2001 - Population Controlling Measure
 
• Made the constitutional amendments beyond judicial scrutiny.
 
• Curtailed the power of judicial review and writ jurisdiction of the Supreme Court and high courts.
 
• Raised the tenure of Lok Sabha and state legislative assemblies from 5 to 6 years.
 
• Provided that the laws made for the implementation of Directive Principles cannot be declared invalid by the courts on the ground of violation of some Fundamental Rights.
 
• Added three new Directive Principles viz., equal justice and free legal aid, the participation of workers in the management of industries and protection of the environment, forests, and wildlife.
 
• Provided for the creation of the All-India Judicial Service.
 
• Shortened the procedure for disciplinary action by taking away the right of a civil servant to make representation at the second stage after the inquiry (i.e., on the penalty proposed).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The** 24th Amendment** had re-established Parliament's authority to amend the Fundamental Rights in the Constitution.
 
• The **25th Amendment **was intended to strip the Supreme Court of the power to go into the quantum of compensation for the takeover of property for public use.
 
• **44th Amendment Act **nullified this unjustified power to the government.
 
• Right to Property was removed from the list of fundamental rights (Article 31) and was made a legal right under Article 300A.
 
• **73rd and 74th Constitutional Amendments** were passed by Parliament in December 1992.
 
• Through these amendments, local self-governance was introduced in rural and urban India.

A 320 m long train A passes a pole in 24 seconds and passes completely another train B running in the opposite direction at 72 km/h in 21 seconds. How much time (in seconds) will train B take to cross completely a tunnel of length 420 m?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Speed of Train A** = 320 ÷ 24 = 40/3 m/s; **Speed of Train B** = 72 × 5/18 = 20 m/s.

Total distance (A + B) = (Relative Speed) × Time = (40/3 + 20) × 21 = (100/3) × 21 = 700 m.

**Length of Train B** = 700 − 320 = 380 m.

**Time for B to cross tunnel** = (380 + 420) ÷ 20 = 800 ÷ 20 = 40 sec.

**∴ The correct answer is 40 sec.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Length of **Train A** = 320 m, **Time** to pass pole = 24 sec, **Speed of Train B** = 72 km/h, **Time** to cross each other = 21 sec, **Tunnel length** = 420 m.

**Formula Used:** **Speed** = **Distance** ÷ **Time**; Relative speed in opposite direction = Sum of speeds.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2ed79b1da5fd8c82700b40fc6fd0905741bad33345a2d391da26e68b28a4fd7.png] 

⇒ Speed of **Train A** (VA) = 320 ÷ 24 = 40/3 m/s

⇒ Speed of **Train B** (VB) = 72 × (5/18) = 20 m/s

⇒ **Relative Speed** = VA + VB = 40/3 + 20 = (40 + 60)/3 = 100/3 m/s

⇒ Total distance covered during crossing = (100/3) × 21 = 700 m

⇒ **Length of Train B** (LB) = 700 − 320 = 380 m

⇒ Total distance to cross tunnel = LB + **Tunnel length** = 380 + 420 = 800 m

⇒ **Time taken** = 800 ÷ 20 = 40 sec

**∴ The correct answer is 40 sec.**

**__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Crossing a Static Object with Length

When a train of length L₁ crosses a platform or tunnel of length L₂, the total distance to be covered is (L₁ + L₂).

Relative Speed Concept

If two objects move in **opposite directions**, relative speed = S₁ + S₂. If they move in the **same direction**, relative speed = |S₁ − S₂|.</p

Value ratio = (1 × 8) ∶ (2 × 5) ∶ (5 × 3) = 8 ∶ 10 ∶ 15

Total value in ratio units = 8 + 10 + 15 = 33 units

33 units = ₹132 ⇒ 1 unit = ₹4

Number of ₹5 coins = 3 ratio units × 4 = 12 coins

**∴ The correct answer is 12 coins.**

Denominations = ₹1, ₹2, ₹5

⇒ Total value of ₹5 coins = 5 × 3x = 15x

⇒ Total value of all coins = 8x + 10x + 15x = 33x

⇒ 33x = 132

⇒ x = 132 ÷ 33

⇒ x = 4

⇒ Number of ₹5 coins = 3x

⇒ Number of ₹5 coins = 3 × 4 = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12 coins.**

questions.question: A piece of programming code inserted into another program to cause damage is called:
questions.solution:
**Correct Answer:** ✅ **Option 1) Virus**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 
 
A **virus** is a piece of malicious programming code that is **inserted into another program**.

 
 
• 
 
When the infected program runs, the virus can execute and **cause damage**, such as corrupting data, slowing the system, or spreading to other programs.

 
 
• 
 
A virus typically **requires a host program** to attach itself to.

 

**Why other options are incorrect:**

 
• 
 
**Malware:** A broad term that includes viruses, worms, trojans, spyware, etc. (too general).

 
 
• 
 
**Spam:** Unwanted or unsolicited messages, usually emails.

 
 
• 
 
**Viral:** Not a technical term used to describe malicious code.

 

 Therefore, the correct answer is **Virus.**
